text: Mabel went first. Cats do not wait for permission.
Gus relit his lantern with a shaking match and followed her down.
Ninety-one steps. He counted every one.
At the bottom the tunnel opened, and the lantern light fell away into a space far too big to be inside an island.
Water, glowing green. A beach of black sand. Crates, rope, a jetty of old wood.
A harbour. Under the lighthouse. And the sand was full of fresh footprints.
